assertions.source_context: Human-adjudicated conclusion by project_owner: Propose none for the ten offered ERC configurations. US manual hardware descriptions distinguish conventional ESS starting equipment from an eTorque motor-generator with hybrid battery and launch assistance; the MY2019 catalog positively identifies conventional without-eTorque alternator applications and a separate ERG BSG application. US offering lineage binds the ten rows to ERC ESS; contemporary MY2020 powertrain materials separately introduce/describe V6 eTorque Sahara. The combined architecture/applicability judgment requires human adjudication; neither ESS terminology, missing eTorque words nor introduction chronology alone establishes nonhybrid status.

Human-adjudicated conclusion by project_owner: Propose naturally_aspirated for the offered ERC 3.6L Pentastar V6 ESS. The MY19 technical guide positively classifies the same marketed family/ESS architecture as naturally aspirated; applicable US guide/specification lineage identifies ERC, its marketed dimensions and trim/body offerings. Induction continuity across these regional implementations is an engineering judgment supported by the combined evidence, not a direct US manufacturer assertion, code-equality proof or inference from absent turbo words alone.
